verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: FALOU mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: בְּיוֹם־ הַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ תָּקִ֕ים אֶת־ מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yō·wm- ha·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš tā·qîm ’eṯ- miš·kan ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: On the first . . . day of the first month you are to set up the tabernacle the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: No primeiro mês, no primeiro dia do mês, levantarás o tabernáculo da tenda da congregação,

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ שָׁ֔ם אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְסַכֹּתָ֥ עַל־ הָאָרֹ֖ן אֶת־ הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tā šām ’êṯ ’ă·rō·wn hā·‘ê·ḏūṯ wə·sak·kō·ṯā ‘al- hā·’ā·rōn ’eṯ- hap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: Put the ark of the Testimony in it and screen off the ark with the veil
verses.literalPt: E porás nele a arca do testemunho, e cobrirás a arca com o véu.

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן וְעָרַכְתָּ֖ אֶת־ עֶרְכּ֑וֹ וְהֵבֵאתָ֙ אֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָ֔ה וְהַעֲלֵיתָ֖ אֶת־ נֵרֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇê·ṯā ’eṯ- haš·šul·ḥān wə·‘ā·raḵ·tā ’eṯ- ‘er·kōw wə·hê·ḇê·ṯā ’eṯ- ham·mə·nō·rāh wə·ha·‘ă·lê·ṯā ’eṯ- nê·rō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Then bring in the table and set out its arrangement bring in the lampstand as well and set up its lamps
verses.literalPt: Depois colocarás nele a mesa, e porás em ordem o que se deve pôr em ordem nela; também colocarás nele o candelabro, e acenderás as suas lâmpadas.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֞ה אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֤ח הַזָּהָב֙ לִקְטֹ֔רֶת לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵדֻ֑ת וְשַׂמְתָּ֛ אֶת־ מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’eṯ- miz·baḥ haz·zā·hāḇ liq·ṭō·reṯ lip̄·nê ’ă·rō·wn hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ wə·śam·tā ’eṯ- mā·saḵ hap·pe·ṯaḥ lam·miš·kān
verses.literal: Place the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the Testimony and hang the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: E porás o altar de ouro para o incenso diante da arca do testemunho; então pendurarás a cortina da porta do tabernáculo.

verses.original: וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ה אֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה לִפְנֵ֕י פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֥ן אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’êṯ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh lip̄·nê pe·ṯaḥ miš·kan ’ō·hel- mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: Porás também o altar do holocausto diante da porta do tabernáculo da tenda da congregação.

verses.original: וְנָֽתַתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין־ אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְנָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖ם מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯa·tā ’eṯ- hak·kî·yōr bên- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ū·ḇên ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·nā·ṯa·tā šām mā·yim
verses.literal: And place the basin between the Tent of Meeting . . . and the altar and put . . . water in it
verses.literalPt: E porás a pia entre a tenda da congregação e o altar, e nela porás água.

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ אֶת־ הֶחָצֵ֖ר סָבִ֑יב וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ אֶת־ מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֥עַר הֶחָצֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tā ’eṯ- he·ḥā·ṣêr sā·ḇîḇ wə·nā·ṯa·tā ’eṯ- mā·saḵ ša·‘ar he·ḥā·ṣêr
verses.literal: Set up the surrounding courtyard and hang the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard
verses.literalPt: Depois porás o pátio ao redor, e pendurarás a cortina à porta do pátio.

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֑וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֖יו וְהָ֥יָה קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’eṯ- še·men ham·miš·ḥāh ū·mā·šaḥ·tā ’eṯ- ham·miš·kān wə·’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer- bōw wə·qid·daš·tā ’ō·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- kāl- kê·lāw wə·hā·yāh qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it consecrate it along with all its furnishings and it shall be holy
verses.literalPt: Então tomarás o azeite da unção, e ungirás o tabernáculo, e tudo o que há nele; e o santificarás com todos os seus pertences, e será santo.

verses.original: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֛ אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·šaḥ·tā ’eṯ- miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- kāl- kê·lāw wə·qid·daš·tā ’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·hā·yāh ham·miz·bê·aḥ qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: Anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils consecrate the altar and it shall be . . . most holy
verses.literalPt: Ungirás também o altar do holocausto, e todos os seus utensílios; e santificarás o altar; e o altar será santíssimo.

verses.original: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֶת־ הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־ כַּנּ֑וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֖ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·šaḥ·tā ’eṯ- hak·kî·yōr wə·’eṯ- kan·nōw wə·qid·daš·tā ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate them
verses.literalPt: Então ungirás a pia e a sua base, e a santificarás.

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֤ אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֔יו אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְרָחַצְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·raḇ·tā ’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’eṯ- bā·nāw ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·rā·ḥaṣ·tā ’ō·ṯām bam·mā·yim
verses.literal: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water
verses.literalPt: Farás também chegar a Arão e a seus filhos à porta da tenda da congregação; e os lavarás com água.

verses.original: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹת֖וֹ וְכִהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hil·baš·tā ’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn ’êṯ biḡ·ḏê haq·qō·ḏeš ū·mā·šaḥ·tā ’ō·ṯōw wə·qid·daš·tā ’ō·ṯōw wə·ḵi·hên lî
verses.literal: And you are to clothe Aaron with the holy garments anoint him and consecrate him so that he may serve Me as a priest
verses.literalPt: E vestirás a Arão as vestes santas, e o ungirás, e o santificarás, para que me administre o sacerdócio.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֖יו תַּקְרִ֑יב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- bā·nāw taq·rîḇ wə·hil·baš·tā ’ō·ṯām kut·to·nōṯ
verses.literal: Bring his sons forward and clothe them with tunics
verses.literalPt: Também farás chegar a seus filhos, e lhes vestirás as túnicas,

verses.original: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר מָשַׁ֙חְתָּ֙ אֶת־ אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וְכִהֲנ֖וּ לִ֑י וְ֠הָיְתָה לִהְיֹ֨ת לָהֶ֧ם מָשְׁחָתָ֛ם לִכְהֻנַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·šaḥ·tā ’ō·ṯām ka·’ă·šer mā·šaḥ·tā ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·hem wə·ḵi·hă·nū lî wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lih·yōṯ lā·hem mā·šə·ḥā·ṯām liḵ·hun·naṯ ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḏō·rō·ṯām
verses.literal: Anoint them just as you anointed their father so that they may also serve Me as priests Their anointing will qualify them for a permanent priesthood throughout their generations
verses.literalPt: E os ungirás como ungiste a seu pai, para que me administrem o sacerdócio, e a sua unção lhes será por sacerdócio perpétuo nas suas gerações.

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś mō·šeh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’ō·ṯōw kên ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: Moses did everything just as the LORD - . . . had commanded him
verses.literalPt: E Moisés fez conforme a tudo o que o SENHOR lhe ordenou, assim o fez.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י בַּחֹ֧דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֛וֹן בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הוּקַ֖ם הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ba·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn baš·šā·nāh haš·šê·nîṯ bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš hū·qam ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month of the second year
verses.literalPt: Assim, no primeiro mês, no ano segundo, ao primeiro dia do mês foi levantado o tabernáculo.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קֶם מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־ אֲדָנָ֔יו וַיָּ֙שֶׂם֙ אֶת־ קְרָשָׁ֔יו וַיִּתֵּ֖ן אֶת־ בְּרִיחָ֑יו וַיָּ֖קֶם אֶת־ עַמּוּדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qem mō·šeh ’eṯ- ham·miš·kān way·yit·tên ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏā·nāw way·yā·śem ’eṯ- qə·rā·šāw way·yit·tên ’eṯ- bə·rî·ḥāw way·yā·qem ’eṯ- ‘am·mū·ḏāw
verses.literal: When Moses set up the tabernacle he laid its bases positioned its frames inserted its crossbars and set up its posts
verses.literalPt: Moisés levantou o tabernáculo, e pôs as suas bases, e armou as suas tábuas, e colocou nele os seus varais, e levantou as suas colunas;

verses.original: וַיִּפְרֹ֤שׂ אֶת־ הָאֹ֙הֶל֙ עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וַיָּ֜שֶׂם אֶת־ מִכְסֵ֥ה הָאֹ֛הֶל עָלָ֖יו מִלְמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·rōś ’eṯ- hā·’ō·hel ‘al- ham·miš·kān way·yā·śem ’eṯ- miḵ·sêh hā·’ō·hel ‘ā·lāw mil·mā·‘ə·lāh ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent . . . . . . just as the LORD had commanded him
verses.literalPt: E estendeu a tenda sobre o tabernáculo, e pôs a cobertura da tenda sobre ela, em cima, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת־ הָעֵדֻת֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אָרֹ֔ן וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־ הַבַּדִּ֖ים עַל־ הָאָרֹ֑ן וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת־ הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל־ הָאָרֹ֖ן מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ way·yit·tên ’eṯ- hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ ’el- hā·’ā·rōn way·yā·śem ’eṯ- hab·bad·dîm ‘al- hā·’ā·rōn way·yit·tên ’eṯ- hak·kap·pō·reṯ ‘al- hā·’ā·rōn mil·mā·‘ə·lāh
verses.literal: Moses took the Testimony and placed it in the ark attaching the poles to the ark and he set the mercy seat atop . . . the ark
verses.literalPt: Tomou o testemunho, e pô-lo na arca, e colocou os varais na arca; e pôs o propiciatório em cima da arca.

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֣א אֶת־ הָאָרֹן֮ אֶל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּן֒ וַיָּ֗שֶׂם אֵ֚ת פָּרֹ֣כֶת הַמָּסָ֔ךְ וַיָּ֕סֶךְ עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇê ’eṯ- hā·’ā·rōn ’el- ham·miš·kān way·yā·śem ’êṯ pā·rō·ḵeṯ ham·mā·sāḵ way·yā·seḵ ‘al ’ă·rō·wn hā·‘ê·ḏūṯ ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle put up the veil for the screen and shielded off the ark of the Testimony just as the LORD had commanded him
verses.literalPt: E introduziu a arca no tabernáculo, e pendurou o véu da cobertura, e cobriu a arca do testemunho, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן צָפֹ֑נָה מִח֖וּץ לַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên ’eṯ- haš·šul·ḥān bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ‘al ye·reḵ ham·miš·kān ṣā·p̄ō·nāh mi·ḥūṣ lap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: Moses placed the table in the Tent of Meeting on the north side of the tabernacle outside the veil
verses.literalPt: Pôs também a mesa na tenda da congregação, ao lado do tabernáculo, para o norte, fora do véu,

verses.original: וַיַּעֲרֹ֥ךְ עָלָ֛יו עֵ֥רֶךְ לֶ֖חֶם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·rōḵ ‘ā·lāw ‘ê·reḵ le·ḥem lip̄·nê Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: He arranged the bread on it . . . before the LORD just as the LORD had commanded him
verses.literalPt: E sobre ela pôs em ordem o pão perante o SENHOR, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם אֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָה֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד נֹ֖כַח הַשֻּׁלְחָ֑ן עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן נֶֽגְבָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem ’eṯ- ham·mə·nō·rāh bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ nō·ḵaḥ haš·šul·ḥān ‘al ye·reḵ ham·miš·kān neḡ·bāh
verses.literal: He also placed the lampstand in the Tent of Meeting opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: Pôs também na tenda da congregação o candelabro na frente da mesa, ao lado do tabernáculo, para o sul,

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַל הַנֵּרֹ֖ת לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al han·nê·rōṯ lip̄·nê Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: and set up the lamps before the LORD just as the LORD had commanded him
verses.literalPt: E acendeu as lâmpadas perante o SENHOR, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיָּ֛שֶׂם אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֥ח הַזָּהָ֖ב בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לִפְנֵ֖י הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem ’eṯ- miz·baḥ haz·zā·hāḇ bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lip̄·nê hap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: Moses placed the gold altar in the Tent of Meeting in front of the veil
verses.literalPt: E pôs o altar de ouro na tenda da congregação, diante do véu,

verses.original: וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·ṭêr ‘ā·lāw qə·ṭō·reṯ sam·mîm ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: and he burned fragrant incense on it just as the LORD had commanded him
verses.literalPt: E acendeu sobre ele o incenso de especiarias aromáticas, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיָּ֛שֶׂם אֶת־ מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem ’eṯ- mā·saḵ hap·pe·ṯaḥ lam·miš·kān
verses.literal: Then he put up the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: Pendurou também a cortina da porta do tabernáculo,

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה שָׂ֕ם פֶּ֖תַח מִשְׁכַּ֣ן אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיַּ֣עַל עָלָ֗יו אֶת־ הָעֹלָה֙ וְאֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh śām pe·ṯaḥ miš·kan ’ō·hel- mō·w·‘êḏ way·ya·‘al ‘ā·lāw ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: He placed the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the tabernacle the Tent of Meeting and offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering just as the LORD had commanded him
verses.literalPt: E pôs o altar do holocausto à porta do tabernáculo da tenda da congregação, e sobre ele ofereceu holocausto e oferta de alimentos, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיָּ֙שֶׂם֙ אֶת־ הַכִּיֹּ֔ר בֵּֽין־ אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן שָׁ֛מָּה מַ֖יִם לְרָחְצָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem ’eṯ- hak·kî·yōr bên- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ū·ḇên ham·miz·bê·aḥ way·yit·tên šām·māh ma·yim lə·rā·ḥə·ṣāh
verses.literal: He placed the basin between the Tent of Meeting . . . and the altar and put water in it for washing
verses.literalPt: Pôs também a pia entre a tenda da congregação e o altar, e nela pôs água para lavar.

verses.original: וְרָחֲצ֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֑יו אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־ רַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·ḥă·ṣū mim·men·nū mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn ū·ḇā·nāw ’eṯ- yə·ḏê·hem wə·’eṯ- raḡ·lê·hem
verses.literal: and from it Moses Aaron and his sons washed their hands and feet
verses.literalPt: E Moisés, e Arão e seus filhos nela lavaram as suas mãos e os seus pés.

verses.original: בְּבֹאָ֞ם אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וּבְקָרְבָתָ֛ם אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִרְחָ֑צוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·ḇō·’ām ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ū·ḇə·qā·rə·ḇā·ṯām ’el- ham·miz·bê·aḥ yir·ḥā·ṣū ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: They washed whenever they entered . . . the Tent of Meeting or approached . . . the altar just as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: Quando entravam na tenda da congregação, e quando chegavam ao altar, lavavam-se, como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קֶם אֶת־ הֶחָצֵ֗ר סָבִיב֙ לַמִּשְׁכָּ֣ן וְלַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַיִּתֵּ֕ן אֶת־ מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֑ר וַיְכַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־ הַמְּלָאכָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qem ’eṯ- he·ḥā·ṣêr sā·ḇîḇ lam·miš·kān wə·lam·miz·bê·aḥ way·yit·tên ’eṯ- mā·saḵ ša·‘ar he·ḥā·ṣêr way·ḵal mō·šeh ’eṯ- ham·mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: And Moses set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and the altar and he hung the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard So Moses finished the work
verses.literalPt: Levantou também o pátio ao redor do tabernáculo e do altar, e pendurou a cortina da porta do pátio. Assim Moisés acabou a obra.

verses.original: וַיְכַ֥ס הֶעָנָ֖ן אֶת־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וּכְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḵas he·‘ā·nān ’eṯ- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ū·ḵə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh mā·lê ’eṯ- ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: Então a nuvem cobriu a tenda da congregação, e a glória do SENHOR encheu o tabernáculo;

verses.original: וְלֹא־ יָכֹ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה לָבוֹא֙ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד כִּֽי־ שָׁכַ֥ן עָלָ֖יו הֶעָנָ֑ן וּכְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מָלֵ֖א אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yā·ḵōl mō·šeh lā·ḇō·w ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ kî- šā·ḵan ‘ā·lāw he·‘ā·nān ū·ḵə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh mā·lê ’eṯ- ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: Moses was unable . . . to enter . . . the Tent of Meeting because the cloud had settled on it and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: De maneira que Moisés não podia entrar na tenda da congregação, porquanto a nuvem permanecia sobre ela, e a glória do SENHOR enchia o tabernáculo.

verses.original: וּבְהֵעָל֤וֹת הֶֽעָנָן֙ מֵעַ֣ל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יִסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּכֹ֖ל מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·hê·‘ā·lō·wṯ he·‘ā·nān mê·‘al ham·miš·kān yis·‘ū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḵōl mas·‘ê·hem
verses.literal: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle the Israelites . . . would set out through all the stages of their journey
verses.literalPt: Quando, pois, a nuvem se levantava de sobre o tabernáculo, então os filhos de Israel caminhavam em todas as suas jornadas.

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֥א יֵעָלֶ֖ה הֶעָנָ֑ן וְלֹ֣א יִסְע֔וּ עַד־ י֖וֹם הֵעָלֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō yê·‘ā·leh he·‘ā·nān wə·lō yis·‘ū ‘aḏ- yō·wm hê·‘ā·lō·ṯōw
verses.literal: If the cloud was not lifted they would not set out until the day it was taken up
verses.literalPt: Se a nuvem, porém, não se levantava, não caminhavam, até ao dia em que ela se levantasse;

verses.original: כִּי֩ עֲנַ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה עַֽל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְאֵ֕שׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַ֖יְלָה בּ֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י כָל־ בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּכָל־ מַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘ă·nan Yah·weh ‘al- ham·miš·kān yō·w·mām wə·’êš tih·yeh lay·lāh bōw lə·‘ê·nê ḵāl bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḵāl mas·‘ê·hem
verses.literal: For the cloud of the LORD was over the tabernacle by day and fire was in the cloud by night in the sight of all the house of Israel through all their journeys
verses.literalPt: Porquanto a nuvem do SENHOR estava de dia sobre o tabernáculo, e o fogo estava de noite sobre ele, perante os olhos de toda a casa de Israel, em todas as suas jornadas.
